artifacts.summary: Re-measures every figure in the task 328 dispatch against the live corpus: confirms both blockers (170, 411) are discharged, finds the 'five-lint cluster' is mechanically a seven-script peer set (two untested), finds task 416 (which lists 328 as its own dependency) has already completed 10/13 phases resolving most of the dispatch's GAP-2 straggler content, confirms GAP 1 (no shared test harness) and most of GAP 3 (selection surface) remain open, and recommends a re-captured net-deletion baseline plus explicit coordination with task 416's remaining phases.

memory_candidates.content: In this repo's agent-system corpus, a probe's duplicate_block_peers field can reveal a cluster larger than a hand-described one: the dispatch for task 328 named a 'five-lint cluster' sharing a byte-identical shared-corpus-enumeration call-site block, but script-inventory.sh's own duplicate_block_peers array showed six peers per file, surfacing two additional lint scripts (lint-hook-registration-paths.sh, lint-shellcheck.sh) with the same duplicated block and no paired test suite. When scoping an extract-a-lib slice from a hand-written task description, cross-check the probe's own peer-list field rather than trusting the description's named set size.

A dependency edge in specs/state.json can point 'backwards' in practice: task 416 lists task 328 in its own dependencies array, yet 416 reached status=implementing with 10/13 plan phases complete while 328 was still in the research phase. The orchestrator batching table (CLAUDE.md) placed 416 in a later batch gated on 328's batch completing, but execution did not honor that ordering. Before planning or implementing a task with a broad file_scope, check whether any task that lists the current task as its own dependency has already progressed past it -- state.json's dependencies array alone will not surface this; the dependent task's own plan-phase-completion state must be read directly.
